H5037.name: Nabal
H5037.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H5037.brief: Wealthy Carmelite; husband of Abigail. He was known for foolishness.
H5037.short: Nabal, a wealthy man from Carmel, was known for his foolishness and mistreatment of David, which nearly led to his demise.

H5022.name: Naboth
H5022.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5022.brief: Jezreelite vineyard owner, unjustly killed by Ahab and Jezebel.
H5022.short: Naboth, a Jezreelite, was unjustly killed by King Ahab and Queen Jezebel for refusing to sell his ancestral vineyard.

H5070I.name: Nadab
H5070I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5070I.brief: Son of Shammai, from the tribe of Judah.
H5070I.short: Nadab was a son of Shammai, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

H5070J.name: Nadab
H5070J.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H5070J.brief: Son of Abiel, from the tribe of Benjamin.
H5070J.short: Nadab was a son of Abiel, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

H5070H.name: Nadab
H5070H.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5070H.brief: King of Israel, son of Jeroboam I, reigned briefly.
H5070H.short: Nadab, the son of Jeroboam I, reigned as king of Israel for two years before being assassinated by Baasha.

H5070G.name: Nadab
H5070G.desc: Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H5070G.brief: Son of Aaron, consumed by fire for offering incense.
H5070G.short: Nadab, the eldest son of Aaron, was consumed by fire from the Lord for offering unauthorized incense.

H5032.name: Nebaioth
H5032.desc: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
H5032.brief: Firstborn son of Ishmael; father of a tribe.
H5032.short: Nebaioth, the firstborn son of Ishmael, was the ancestor of a tribe known for their flocks and mentioned in Isaiah's prophecy of future blessing.

H5028.name: Nebat
H5028.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H5028.brief: Father of Jeroboam, the first king of Israel.
H5028.short: Nebat was the father of Jeroboam I, who became the first king of the northern kingdom of Israel after the division of the monarchy.

H5019.name: Nebuchadnezzar
H5019.desc: Emperor living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5019.brief: Emperor of Babylon who conquered Judah
H5019.short: Nebuchadnezzar II was the powerful Emperor of Babylon who destroyed Jerusalem and exiled the Jews.

H5021.name: Nebushazban
H5021.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5021.brief: Babylonian official during the fall of Jerusalem.
H5021.short: Nebushazban, a Babylonian official, was among those who took charge of Jeremiah after the fall of Jerusalem.

H5018.name: Nebuzaradan
H5018.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5018.brief: Babylonian captain of the guard during Jerusalem's fall.
H5018.short: Nebuzaradan, the captain of the Babylonian guard, oversaw the destruction of Jerusalem, the exile of its inhabitants, and the release of Jeremiah.

H5072.name: Nedabiah
H5072.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5072.brief: Descendant of King Jeconiah of Judah
H5072.short: Nedabiah was a descendant of Jeconiah, the exiled king of Judah.

H5025G.name: Nobah
H5025G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H5025G.short: Nobah was an Israelite who captured the town of Kenath and renamed it after himself.

H5052.name: Nogah
H5052.desc: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
H5052.short: Nogah was one of King David's sons born in Jerusalem.

H5096.name: Nahalol
H5096.short: Nahalol, also called Nahalal, was a Levitical city in the territory of Zebulun.

H5041.name: Neballat
H5041.brief: A town in Benjamin inhabited by Benjamites after the exile
H5041.short: Neballat was a town in the territory of Benjamin where some Benjamites settled after returning from the Babylonian exile.

H5015G.name: Nebo
H5015G.brief: A town in Judah, possibly named after a person
H5015G.short: Nebo was a town in Judah, possibly named after a person, whose inhabitants returned from the Babylonian exile.

H5015A.name: Nebo
H5015A.brief: A city and mountain in Moab
H5015A.short: Nebo was a city and mountain in Moab, mentioned in the Old Testament.

H5015H.name: Nebo Mount
H5015H.brief: The mountain where Moses viewed the Promised Land
H5015H.short: Mount Nebo, also called Abarim, was the mountain from which Moses viewed the Promised Land before his death.

H5045G.name: Negeb
H5045G.brief: The southern region of Israel, a semi-arid area
H5045G.short: The Negeb, meaning "south," refers to the semi-arid region in the southern part of Israel.

H5044.name: Nibshan
H5044.brief: A town in the Judean wilderness
H5044.short: Nibshan was a town in the wilderness of Judah, mentioned in the list of towns allotted to the tribe of Judah.

H5011.name: Nob
H5011.brief: A city of priests near Jerusalem
H5011.short: Nob was a city of priests near Jerusalem, known for a massacre ordered by King Saul and as a temporary location of the Ark of the Covenant.

H5015B.name: Nebo
H5015B.brief: A Babylonian god and a mountain in Moab
H5015B.short: Nebo, mentioned in Isaiah 46:1, is a Babylonian god of wisdom and writing, and also the name of a mountain in Moab where Moses viewed the Promised Land before his death (<ref="Deu.32.49; 34:1">Deu.32.49; 34:1</ref>).

H5026.name: Nibhaz
H5026.brief: Idol god worshiped by the Avvites in Samaria
H5026.short: Nibhaz was a deity worshiped by the Avvite people who settled in Samaria.
